claims.claim: On Friday Donald Trump posted support for Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s efforts to assert state authority, stop oil smuggling, end corruption, and bring all weapons under exclusive state control.
claims.episode_span: We support Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s efforts to assert state authority throughout Iraq
claims.source_title: Why is Trump backing Iraq’s anti-smuggling campaign?
claims.supporting_quote: In a post on Truth Social on Friday, Trump wrote: “We support Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s efforts to assert state authority throughout Iraq, stop the smuggling of Iraqi oil, end corruption, and bring all weapons under the exclusive control of the state.

claims.claim: Trump also wrote that the United States supports al-Zaidi’s efforts to build a united, prosperous, and strong Iraq that makes its own political decisions.
claims.episode_span: build a united, prosperous, and strong Iraq that makes its own political decisions
claims.source_title: Why is Trump backing Iraq’s anti-smuggling campaign?
claims.supporting_quote: “We support Prime Minister al-Zaidi’s efforts to build a united, prosperous, and strong Iraq that makes its own political decisions,” he added.

claims.claim: The post was Washington’s first comment on tensions between Baghdad and Erbil, and talks are due on December 1 under the head of Iraq’s Supreme Judicial Council.
claims.episode_span: the post was Washington’s first comment on the tensions between Baghdad and Erbil
claims.source_title: Why is Trump backing Iraq’s anti-smuggling campaign?
claims.supporting_quote: The post marked Washington’s first comment on tensions between Baghdad and Erbil.

claims.claim: On Tuesday al-Zaidi moved to place Kurdish border crossings and several oilfields under federal control; on Wednesday Iraq’s top court ruled Baghdad can deploy federal forces on all international borders including the Kurdish region; on Thursday Iraq closed two crossings, one with Syria and one with Iran.
claims.episode_span: On Thursday, Iraq closed two crossings in that region, one with Syria and one with Iran.
claims.source_title: Why is Trump backing Iraq’s anti-smuggling campaign?
claims.supporting_quote: On Thursday, Iraq closed two crossings in the region, one with Syria and one with Iran.

claims.claim: Haider al-Aboudi told the Iraqi News Agency that Iraq lost an estimated $100 billion between 2008 and 2025 from oil smuggled through the Kurdish region.
claims.episode_span: Iraq has lost an estimated $100 billion between 2008 and 2025 from oil smuggled through the Kurdish region
claims.source_title: Why is Trump backing Iraq’s anti-smuggling campaign?
claims.supporting_quote: Government spokesperson Haider al-Aboudi told the Iraqi News Agency (INA) that Iraq has lost an estimated $100bn between 2008 and 2025 from oil smuggled through the region.

claims.claim: Senior Iraqi officials told Reuters that Kataib Hezbollah ran an oil smuggling network in Jurf al-Sakhar siphoning state crude worth hundreds of millions of dollars since 2021; the group denies the allegations.
claims.episode_span: siphoning off state-owned crude worth hundreds of millions of dollars since 2021
claims.source_title: Why is Trump backing Iraq’s anti-smuggling campaign?
claims.supporting_quote: Senior Iraqi security, army, police and oil officials told the Reuters news agency that Kataib Hezbollah has since run an oil smuggling network there, siphoning off state-owned crude worth hundreds of millions of dollars since 2021.

claims.claim: Nine senior security and oil officials have been dismissed and referred to the courts.
claims.episode_span: Nine senior security and oil officials have been dismissed and referred to the courts.

claims.supporting_quote: Nine senior security and oil officials have been dismissed and referred to the courts .

claims.claim: A compromise before the November 20 deadline, reportedly after Esmail Qaani’s intervention, put government forces into Jurf al-Sakhar with a joint operations centre and a gradual withdrawal of Kataib Hezbollah units.
claims.episode_span: government forces entered Jurf al-Sakhar and set up a joint operations centre

claims.supporting_quote: Under the deal, government forces entered Jurf al-Sakhar and set up a joint operations centre.

claims.claim: Harakat al-Nujaba and Kataib Sayyid al-Shuhada have refused to disarm, and the government pushed the weapons deadline from September 30 to June 2027.
claims.episode_span: the government pushed the deadline to June 2027
claims.source_title: Why is Trump backing Iraq’s anti-smuggling campaign?
claims.supporting_quote: After the armed groups missed a September 30 deadline to hand over their weapons to the state, the government pushed the deadline to June 2027 .

claims.claim: France 24 reported that al-Zaidi’s oil-smuggling steps, praised by the US, risk putting him at odds with Iraq’s Kurds and neighbouring Iran.

claims.source_title: Syrian Kurds protest against Baghdad leader's moves to assert central control
claims.supporting_quote: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi is taking bold steps to curb rampant oil smuggling, moves that the US has praised but that risk putting him at odds with Iraq's Kurds and neighbouring Iran.

claims.claim: WHO estimated 9.8 million measles cases and about 72,000 deaths worldwide in 2025, down 74 percent from 37.8 million cases in 2000 and roughly 91 percent from about 769,000 deaths.
